end.title: One verified science story a day

caption:
A UCSF team used an ECoG brain-computer interface with machine-learning decoders so paralysed participants could speak and gesture through an avatar at the same time. Three participants, wired, in a lab setting. Nature Neuroscience, 2026.

#neuroscience #bci #science #neurotech
voiceover_script: She cannot move or speak. Her avatar can do both, straight from her brain. This is a brain-computer interface from UCSF. An implant called ECoG records signals from the brain. Machine-learning decoders turn those signals into speech and into body language, and an on-screen avatar performs both at the same time. Talking and gesturing together, the way people actually communicate. Now the honest part. Three participants. A wired connection. A lab setting. This is a demonstration, not a treatment you can go and get. But it is the first time speech and body language have been decoded together like this. Nature Neuroscience, this month. Source in the caption.
